dedupe_keys.name: hourly renewable energy generation and electricity demand in ireland in 2050

description: Hourly renewable energy generation and electricity demand in Ireland in 2050 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Charlene Vance, Aina Maimó Far (University College Dublin). This dataset contains hourly data (in MW) for renewable energy generation and electricity demand in 2050 for the Republic of Ireland. Coverage: national (IE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
name: Hourly renewable energy generation and electricity demand in Ireland in 2050
